semantics.definition: The rules every Eidos share must meet.
semantics.responsibility: Say how much of another value something is in the 3D world: the drone's ring is 0.84 of its body's radius, and a border grows by 0.5 of the base's growth.

share.description: How much of another value something is in the 3D world, a plain number to the ten-thousandth: 0 (none of it) to 10 (ten times it); 1 is all of it. Which value it is a share of is said in its definition.
